description: This file defines a StaffingPlan document class with validation and calculation methods for staffing planning, including handling hierarchical company structures and associated staffing details.

classes.name: SubsidiaryCompanyError
classes.description: ValidationError for subsidiary company related issues

classes.name: ParentCompanyError
classes.description: ValidationError for parent company related issues

classes.name: StaffingPlan
classes.description: Main document class for managing staffing plans, including validation, budget calculation, and hierarchical validation methods

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Main validation method called before saving, triggers period, details, and budget validation

methods.name: validate_period
methods.description: Validates that from_date is not after to_date

methods.name: validate_details
methods.description: Validates each staffing detail for overlaps and hierarchical consistency

methods.name: set_total_estimated_budget
methods.description: Calculates total estimated budget based on staffing details

methods.name: set_number_of_positions
methods.description: Sets total number of positions for a staffing detail

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping staffing plans for the same designation and date range

methods.name: validate_with_parent_plan
methods.description: Ensures staffing plan does not exceed parent company's plan

methods.name: validate_with_subsidiary_plans
methods.description: Ensures staffing plan does not undercut subsidiary companies' plans

methods.name: get_designation_counts
methods.description: Returns counts of active employees and open job openings for a designation within a company hierarchy

methods.name: get_active_staffing_plan_details
methods.description: Fetches active staffing plan details for a company and designation within a date range, including hierarchy fallback
